# IETF interoperability model set

These unmodified modules form the dependency closure used by the real-model
conformance tests. They were retrieved on 2026-08-13 from the `standard/ietf/RFC`
directory of the YangModels/yang GitHub repository. Each YANG file retains its
own IETF Trust copyright and license text; the project Apache-2.0 license does
not replace those terms.

- `ietf-interfaces@2018-02-20.yang` — RFC 8343
- `ietf-yang-types@2013-07-15.yang` — RFC 6991
- `ietf-inet-types@2013-07-15.yang` — RFC 6991

SHA-256 pins, in the same order as the files when sorted by filename:

- `ietf-inet-types`: `12d98b0143a5ca5095b36420f9ebc1ffa61cfd2eaa850080244cadf01b86ddf9`
- `ietf-interfaces`: `f6faea9938f0341ed48fda93dba9a69aa32ee7142c463342efec3d38f4eb3621`
- `ietf-yang-types`: `a04cdcc875764a76e89b7a0200c6b9d800b10713978093acda7840c7c2907c3f`

The exact files are pinned rather than refreshed automatically so test results
remain reproducible. Update them deliberately, record new revisions here, and
review upstream license notices before replacement.
